Method of Attack: Downloader delivering multiple information stealers and ransomware strains; delivers next-stage payload from command and control server; operator rents it to other cybercriminals to distribute various malware
Impacted Systems: Government entities in Asia-Pacific (APAC) and North America regions
Attack Vector: Email with Discord app URL pointing to PureCrypter sample in password-protected ZIP archive; compromised non-profit organization server used as command and control server
Indicators of Compromise: Discord hosting initial payload; compromised non-profit organization server; password-protected ZIP archive containing PureCrypter sample
